record.bible_text: Woe<WH01945> to them <FI>that are<Fi> at ease<WH07600> in Zion<WH06726>, and trust<WH0982><WTH8802> in the mountain<WH02022> of Samaria<WH08111>, <FI>which are<Fi> named<WH05344><WTH8803> chief<WH07225> of the nations<WH01471>, to whom the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478> came<WH0935><WTH8804>! <RF>are at...: or, are secure<Rf> <RF>chief: or, firstfruits<Rf>

Pass<WH05674><WTH8798> ye unto Calneh<WH03641>, and see<WH07200><WTH8798>; and from thence go<WH03212><WTH8798> ye to Hamath<WH02574> the great<WH07227><WTH8677><WH02579>: then go down<WH03381><WTH8798> to Gath<WH01661> of the Philistines<WH06430>: <FI>be they<Fi> better<WH02896> than these kingdoms<WH04467>? or their border<WH01366> greater<WH07227> than your border<WH01366>?
Ye that put far away<WH05077><WTH8764> the evil<WH07451> day<WH03117>, and cause the seat<WH07675><WTH8800> of violence<WH02555> to come near<WH05066><WTH8686>; <RF>seat: or, habitation<Rf>

That lie<WH07901><WTH8802> upon beds<WH04296> of ivory<WH08127>, and stretch<WH05628><WTH8803> themselves upon their couches<WH06210>, and eat<WH0398><WTH8802> the lambs<WH03733> out of the flock<WH06629>, and the calves<WH05695> out of the midst<WH08432> of the stall<WH04770>; <RF>stretch...: or, abound with superfluities<Rf>

That chant<WH06527><WTH8802> to the sound<WH06310> of the viol<WH05035>, <FI>and<Fi> invent<WH02803><WTH8804> to themselves instruments<WH03627> of musick<WH07892>, like David<WH01732>; <RF>chant: or, quaver<Rf>

That drink<WH08354><WTH8802> wine<WH03196> in bowls<WH04219>, and anoint<WH04886><WTH8799> themselves with the chief<WH07225> ointments<WH08081>: but they are not grieved<WH02470><WTH8738> for the affliction<WH07667> of Joseph<WH03130>. <RF>wine...: or, in bowls of wine<Rf> <RF>affliction: Heb. breach<Rf>

Therefore now shall they go captive<WH01540><WTH8799> with the first<WH07218> that go captive<WH01540><WTH8802>, and the banquet<WH04797> of them that stretched<WH05628><WTH8803> themselves shall be removed<WH05493><WTH8804>.<CM>

The Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> hath sworn<WH07650><WTH8738> by himself<WH05315>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068> the God<WH0430> of hosts<WH06635>, I abhor<WH08374><WTH8764> the excellency<WH01347> of Jacob<WH03290>, and hate<WH08130><WTH8804> his palaces<WH0759>: therefore will I deliver up<WH05462><WTH8689> the city<WH05892> with all that is therein<WH04393>. <RF>that...: Heb. the fulness thereof<Rf>
And it shall come to pass, if there remain<WH03498><WTH8735> ten<WH06235> men<WH0582> in one<WH0259> house<WH01004>, that they shall die<WH04191><WTH8804>.

And a man's uncle<WH01730> shall take him up<WH05375><WTH8804>, and he that burneth<WH05635><WTH8764> him, to bring out<WH03318><WTH8687> the bones<WH06106> out of the house<WH01004>, and shall say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto him that <FI>is<Fi> by the sides<WH03411> of the house<WH01004>, <FI>Is there<Fi> yet <FI>any<Fi> with thee? and he shall say<WH0559><WTH8804>, No<WH0657>. Then shall he say<WH0559><WTH8804>, Hold thy tongue<WH02013><WTH8761>: for we may not make mention<WH02142><WTH8687> of the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>we...: or, they will not, or, have not<Rf>

For, behold, the LORD<WH03068> commandeth<WH06680><WTH8764>, and he will smite<WH05221><WTH8689> the great<WH01419> house<WH01004> with breaches<WH07447>, and the little<WH06996> house<WH01004> with clefts<WH01233>. <RF>breaches: or, droppings<Rf>

Shall horses<WH05483> run<WH07323><WTH8799> upon the rock<WH05553>? will <FI>one<Fi> plow<WH02790><WTH8799> <FI>there<Fi> with oxen<WH01241>? for ye have turned<WH02015><WTH8804> judgment<WH04941> into gall<WH07219>, and the fruit<WH06529> of righteousness<WH06666> into hemlock<WH03939>:
Ye which rejoice<WH08056> in a thing<WH01697> of nought<WH03808>, which say<WH0559><WTH8802>, Have we not taken<WH03947><WTH8804> to us horns<WH07161> by our own strength<WH02392>?

But, behold, I will raise up<WH06965><WTH8688> against you a nation<WH01471>, O house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068> the God<WH0430> of hosts<WH06635>; and they shall afflict<WH03905><WTH8804> you from the entering in<WH0935><WTH8800> of Hemath<WH02574> unto the river<WH05158> of the wilderness<WH06160>. <RF>river: or, valley<Rf><CM>
